reason: This repository is primarily an automation plugin for connecting an AI agent with a local MATLAB/Simulink environment: the DSH Node host plugin and MATLAB daemon exchange task and response JSON files to expose 20 `matlab_*` tools for editor/code inspection and Simulink model operations. The core capability set includes command execution and model mutation actions, so it is useful for agent-driven MATLAB workflows but carries elevated local risk from direct code and model modification.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH 插件，通过本地文件 IPC 在 AI 与 MATLAB 之间传递任务和结果，提供 `matlab_*` 工具用于编辑器代码读取/修改以及 Simulink 模型的查询和操作。
summaries.en: This is a DSH plugin that connects an AI agent to a local MATLAB instance via file-based IPC, exposing `matlab_*` tools for reading/editing editor content and interacting with Simulink models.

capabilities: Read and modify editor content/files through dedicated tools
Inspect and manipulate open editors and workspace data
Create/read/update Simulink model structure and parameters

reasons.code: README describes a Node.js DSH plugin registering 20 `matlab_*` tools, including execution and model-modifying actions such as `matlab_eval`, `matlab_replace_text`, `matlab_add_block`, `matlab_add_line`, and `matlab_run_simulation`.

README defines architecture using file IPC with `%USERPROFILE%\\.deepseek\\requests` and `responses` plus a MATLAB daemon polling every 2 seconds; this is a local command/response bridge with direct action hooks.
README and package.json show `package.json` metadata and DSH bundle wiring (`cordis.patch.yml`) indicating the plugin is packaged for direct host integration rather than a passive library.

capabilities: Read and modify editor content/files through dedicated tools
Inspect and manipulate open editors and workspace data
Create/read/update Simulink model structure and parameters
